rows.quote: MRS. GLADYS L. BROWN 1931-1938 1948-1970 Mrs. Brown began her teaching duties with the Lunenburg School System as Gladys A. Leonard in September 1931 when she was hired as teacher of Grade I in the old Center School. She remained in this position until June of 1938 when she resigned to be married. rows.quote: WILLIAM F. MORAN 1962-1970 "Bill" first began his employment with the School Department on April 30, 1962, when he was hired as a Custodian in the Jr.-Sr. High School. When the new Turkey Hill Middle School opened, Bill was unanimously appointed as the new Senior Custodian by the School Committee in September 1968, assuming his duties effective December 30, 1968. He remained in this position until December 30, 1970,
